question: Apakah aplikasi sudah memiliki fitur PCB Auto-Place & Auto-Route seperti yang disebut orang tersebut?
probes: grep PCB in app/src found no PCB view
the request asks for schematic capture and simulation only
resolution: No PCB workspace or auto-place/auto-route exists, and the current request does not ask for one. Earlier work left dormant footprint, catalog and placement data plus two orphan module declarations whose files never existed; those declarations were removed so the build succeeds.
